quand: When the designer moves the order to the “Dispatched” step, with the carrier’s tracking number if it is known.
sujet: Your piece is on its way
preheader: It has left the atelier, folded in its tissue paper.

suivi.description: The order tracking link (no account needed)

numeroSuivi.description: The carrier’s tracking number, when it is known

lienColis.description: The link to track the parcel on the carrier’s website

relais.description: The pick-up point chosen, if there is one

blocs.titre: Your piece is on its way

blocs.texte:
Dear {prenom},

Your piece has left the atelier, folded in its tissue paper, with its certificate of authenticity.
It is travelling with {transporteur}, tracking number {numeroSuivi}: {lienColis}
The carrier’s tracking number will reach you as soon as the parcel is collected.
It will be waiting for you at the pick-up point {relais}.
Your order {commande}, its invoice and its certificate: {suivi}

Until very soon,
The Awrea Paris atelier
